name: Rebuild Posted Data
purpose: Rebuilds the posted-data summary: empties the f_SummaryByMonth table, then goes through every SalesTransaction record and posts it by calling Post/Unpost Internal with Post = true.
reads: SalesTransaction::id#1 (step 10, each record in the found set from step 7)
writes: delete: SumaryByMonth (Truncate Table step 4, all records of the current table)
open_question: Posts all sales transactions, whatever their current posted state; the posting rules and the writes to the summary are in script 576, outside this batch. Truncate Table is destructive. In Scripts menu only.
